name: Sono Aki no Yoru ni
source:
There is a small pension house in the mountains. A group of six photography department students board in here. Their pleasant adventure is interrupted by a murder. Who is the criminal?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
山间有一家小旅馆，六名摄影系学生结伴住在这里。一桩谋杀案打断了他们愉快的旅程。凶手究竟是谁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
